description.p: Meduza Music is a blisteringly fast desktop music client for YouTube Music, built from scratch in Rust using GPU-accelerated egui and mpv live streaming.

ul.li: Instant InnerTube API search with debounced suggestions
Low-latency mpv audio streaming with background URL preloading
Synchronized lyrics from LRCLIB in the full-screen player
MPRIS2 and global media-key support on Linux
Modern Spotify-inspired UI with smooth rounding
